title: Investigate high E4 guitar note detection
description: User reports physical high E4 note is not heard. Reproduce with realistic synthetic plucks and inspect pitch/tracker thresholds. Ask what HEARD displays; fix only demonstrated issues, record real recording accuracy limits.
notes: User reports high E and B strings largely unresponsive; D4 on B string works. Reproduced harmonic-heavy E4 mistaken for E5 and upper-note downsampling-resolution failure. Fixed with higher reduced sampling and conservative original-PCM period comparison; 33 pitch tests / 67 total unit tests and 25 browser scenarios pass. Live Tailscale HTTPS synthetic harmonic-heavy E4 microphone pipeline recognizes and advances. Physical phone/guitar confirmation still pending; RMS detector .006 and UI .008 unchanged. User prioritizes trying phone on hosted app.

title: Serve GuitarFlow over private Tailscale HTTPS
description: Build a path-aware static deployment and add /guitarflow on this machine existing Tailscale HTTPS endpoint without replacing existing services. Verify HTTPS, assets and secure-context microphone API, document rebuild workflow, export tracking and push.
notes: Deployment build and /guitarflow/ asset-path browser smoke passed. Local Tailscale node is dcmini-1.tail1e3236.ts.net. Serve mutation rejected Access denied; sudo -n requires a password. Existing Serve configuration confirmed unchanged. Needs local operator to run sudo tailscale serve --bg --https=443 --set-path=/guitarflow /home/notdc/projects/guitarflow/dist-tailscale, then verify real HTTPS browser loading and secure microphone context. Deployment is not live yet.

title: Add acoustic-friendly popular song practice loops
description: Add recognizable Nirvana, Pink Floyd and other acoustic-friendly songs as explicitly simplified playable chord loops with checked lesson links, song search, known-chord filtering, and no lyrics/tab/audio copying. Verify cue playback and existing note/rhythm flows, document scope, export tracking and push.
acceptance_criteria: Nirvana and Pink Floyd represented; song-specific simplification/tuning/capo notes visible; playable compatible chord loops and search work; tests/build pass; docs and tracking pushed.
close_reason: Implemented eight simplified acoustic song loops with checked teacher lesson links, adaptation notes, title/artist search, library filters and visible-result shuffle. npm run check passes 60 unit tests and 25 browser tests. Production catalog/search/selection smoke passed and desktop screenshot reviewed. docs/acoustic-songs.md records sources and scope. Implementation pushed in 66ad79f.

title: Add single-note listening and guitar neck practice
description: Identify individual guitar notes with octave and tuning feedback locally, show possible string/fret positions, and advance a note exercise only after stable correct note detection. Preserve existing chord/rhythm flows.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic pitch and rejection tests pass; real browser microphone flow waits on wrong notes and advances on correct notes; neck is accessible/mobile; existing tests/build pass; docs and tracking pushed.
close_reason: Verified: npm run check passes 56 unit and 22 Chrome browser tests; production preview neck rendering/selection passed; reviewed desktop/mobile screenshots; docs/single-notes.md records scope and accuracy limits; implementation pushed in 8ed01bb. Also fixed scheduler anchoring to retain the first count-in click under load.

title: Integrate, test and document first release
description: Own build configuration, integration, browser tests, README and release evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Production build, type check, unit tests and browser scenarios pass; microphone-denied and corrupt upload paths handled; limitations and launch instructions recorded.
close_reason: Typecheck, 21 unit tests, production build, 17 browser cases, formatting and production smoke passed; docs/version-1.md and README committed and pushed.

title: Browser practice interface and audio controls
description: Own responsive React interface, microphone/WAV upload lifecycle, editable strumming grid, arrangement choice, audio-clock playback and experimental chord feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Local recording/upload paths and errors work; cues advance by chord duration; pause/restart controls and mobile layout work; no audio uploaded.
close_reason: Browser interface and AudioWorklet capture implemented; 17 Chromium scenarios passed; screenshots reviewed; all source-review findings resolved.

title: Core rhythm, chord and arrangement engine
description: Own pure audio analysis, versioned types, original practice library, transport calculations and unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown direction retained; silence rejected; onsets/rhythm and synthetic chord checks tested; elapsed audio time drives song position.
close_reason: Core engine and versioned contracts implemented; 21 unit tests passed via npm run check; docs/data-contract.md records limits.

title: Build and verify GuitarFlow version one
description: Deliver a runnable local-first browser app for rhythm capture, pattern correction, compatible practice arrangements, audio-clock chord cues, and experimental chord checking. Test core behavior and real browser flows. The earlier research epic remains open where real guitar recordings and comparisons are unfulfilled.
acceptance_criteria: App builds and runs; recording/upload and error paths work; deterministic tests and browser checks pass; limitations and start commands documented; changes pushed.
close_reason: First runnable version built, tested, documented and pushed; production preview running on localhost:4180. Real-guitar accuracy and live tempo following remain in phase-one research.

title: Review feasibility evidence and define the next phase
description: Combine rhythm detection, cue usability, chord comparison and live-following evidence. Compare results to the frozen contract; explain limitations and choose whether to expand catalogue, tracking or direction detection.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence-backed report links reproducible commands and artifacts; gaps become Beads follow-ups; next scope reflects measured results, not assumed accuracy.

title: Build fixed-tempo current and next chord prototype
description: Build browser cue interface with count-in, large current/next chord, countdown, pause/restart and tempo control. Schedule from audio clock; do not advance once per strum. Let the player correct and replay captured rhythm.
acceptance_criteria: Three checked arrangements playable without separate charts; missed strums cannot skip chords; scheduling drift measured over a three-minute replay; works with recognition disabled.

title: Build recorded-pattern timing baseline
description: Detect strum starts, estimate tempo, resolve bar start with count-in or confirmation, merge string attacks, map events to an eighth-note grid and return confidence. Measure clean held-out precision/recall and timing error.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible report compares against frozen targets; half/double-tempo errors reported; editable rhythm data produced; no invented up/down certainty.

title: Collect and label pilot guitar recordings
description: Collect 30 clean pattern clips and at least 12 challenge clips plus supported chord examples, as specified in the plan. Record real equipment and reserve whole later sessions for evaluation. Keep private audio out of git.
acceptance_criteria: Strum/bar/chord annotations and metadata validate; missed-strum/pause/noise examples exist; evaluation split is documented and private audio ignored.

title: Set up reproducible audio experiments
description: Create the smallest Python experiment environment for librosa and Basic Pitch comparison. Record Python/library versions and commands; check code/model licenses. No model training or cloud inference required.
acceptance_criteria: A clean environment can load a sample, extract onset/chroma features, run note estimation, and reproduce results with documented commands.

title: Phase one: prove rhythm capture and useful chord cues
description: Execute docs/phase-1-plan.md. Deliver a measured feasibility result before expanding song selection or training a model.
acceptance_criteria: Rhythm analysis, cue prototype, chord comparison and feasibility report exist with reproducible evidence; all required child tasks are completed.

title: Define experiment contract and versioned data formats
description: Define pattern events in beats, tempo, meter, bar-start offset, confidence, optional stroke labels; arrangement timing and provenance; recording metadata and session-level evaluation split. Freeze phase-one targets before held-out evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: Document formats and valid examples; unknown stroke labels remain unknown; development/evaluation split and metrics are fixed.

title: Set up repository, phase-one plan, and project tracking
description: Create private GitHub repository, initial research, phase-one plan and project-local Beads tasks with verified dependencies and persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Documents pushed; Beads tasks survive fresh reads; repository verified private.
close_reason: Repository and phase-one documents pushed; 11 issues and dependencies verified; GitHub visibility PRIVATE.

title: Test causal live timing and pause recovery
description: After fixed-tempo cues work, test whether a causal tracker can follow tempo changes and recover after pauses. Use rhythm and song position; repeated chords must not cause false advancement. Retain fixed-tempo mode if unreliable.
acceptance_criteria: Record live/replay cue timing, missed-strum handling and pause-recovery time; document fallback and confidence policy; no dependence on future audio.

title: Compare chord-template matching and Basic Pitch
description: Compare chroma templates and grouped note estimates on the same reserved recordings. Test expected-chord checking and unrestricted candidates, transition audio, partial chords, wrong chords and unknown outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Per-chord confusion, coverage/rejection, accuracy, window length and end-to-end delay documented; recommend a baseline without claiming live performance before measurement.

title: Prepare checked practice arrangements
description: Create an initial progression and 3–5 reusable arrangements with exact chord durations, sections, meter, key, capo/tuning and compatible rhythm tags. Track reuse permission separately from recordings.
acceptance_criteria: Each arrangement validates and chord durations/changes are manually checked; source/permission recorded; no claim that rhythm uniquely identifies songs.
close_reason: Six original practice arrangements authored with checked chord durations, keys, standard tuning, fingerings and provenance; src/core/arrangements.ts and unit/browser checks verify library behavior.
